ai.seo_question: Who is al-Sharif al-Sayyid al-Murtada 'Alam al-Huda Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa al-Musawi?
ai.summary: This text is a brief biographical identification naming al-Sharif al-Sayyid al-Murtada, known as 'Alam al-Huda, Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa al-Musawi. It serves to identify a prominent scholarly figure rather than to convey a legal or doctrinal teaching.
